name: vj-achievement-universe
description: A gamified, space-themed developer portfolio and certification vault styled as a sci-fi telemetry HUD. Features an interactive orbital galaxy system, credential decryption diagnostics, trophy room, badge wall, live system load dashboard, and immersive sound effects.

paragraphs: Welcome to the Cosmic Certificate & Achievement Decryption Console—a highly gamified, interactive, space-themed developer portfolio and certification vault. Built to look and feel like a sci-fi telemetry HUD (Heads-Up Display), this application catalogs and decrypts 170+ verified credentials, including internships, hackathons, courses, workshops, skill badges, and competitive programming milestones.
Designed with rich, futuristic aesthetics, glassmorphism, smooth neon gradients, micro-animations, optimized canvas particle systems, custom Web Audio API feedback, and 3D hover interactions.

System Alert: This application utilizes high-fidelity canvas processing, audio ripples, and Framer Motion state transitions. Make sure your browser's audio permissions are active to experience full sound telemetry.
